sentences.text: The coins of the Swiss franc are the official coins used in Switzerland and Liechtenstein .	Swiss franc	Swiss franc	Switzerland	Switzerland	Liechtenstein	Liechtenstein
The name of the subunit is Centime in French , Rappen in German , Centisimo in Italian and Rap in Romansh .	Centime	Centime	Rappen	Rappen
There are coins in denominations of 5 centimes , 10 centimes , 20 centimes , 1/2 franc -LRB- 50 centimes -RRB- , 1 franc , 2 francs and 5 francs .
In the past , there were also coins of 1 and 2 centimes .
